title: Dimension bound from generic residue-field transcendence degrees
statement: Let $f:Y\to S$ be a locally finite type morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with $S$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let $d,n\geq0$ be integers. Use topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], with $\dim\varnothing=-\infty$. Assume $\dim S\leq d$. For every generic point $\eta$ [def-sc-generic-point] of an irreducible component of $Y$ [def-weil-irreducible-components], assume that the residue-field extension induced by $f$ satisfies $\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(f(\eta))}\kappa(\eta)\leq n$ [def-weil-residue-field, def-kun-transcendence-degree]. Then $\dim Y\leq d+n$. No irreducibility, reducedness, dominance, quasi-compactness, separatedness, properness, or surjectivity hypothesis is imposed on $f$ or $Y$; empty schemes are allowed.

source.place: Tag 0BAG, lemma-alteration-dimension-general, specialized to the bounds dim(S) <= d and E <= n; its input is Tag 0BAE, lemma-dimension-formula-general.

proof.text: If $Y=\varnothing$, the conclusion is $-\infty\leq d+n$ by the stipulated dimension convention. Otherwise fix an arbitrary point $y\in Y$ and put $s=f(y)$.

source.place: Tag 0BAG, lemma-alteration-dimension-general; empty case separated explicitly.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-local-dimension-formula-generic-components] to $f$ at $y$: its hypotheses are precisely local finite type and local Noetherianity of $S$. It supplies the finite nonempty set $G_y$ of generic points of components through $y$, its maximum $E_y$, and $\dim\mathcal O_{Y,y}+\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(s)}\kappa(y)\leq\dim\mathcal O_{S,s}+E_y$. Every member of $G_y$ is one of the generic points covered by the hypothesis of the item, so every term of this maximum is at most $n$, hence $E_y\leq n$. The residue transcendence degree at $y$ is nonnegative. By [lem-pc-scheme-dimension-local-rings] for $S$, $\dim\mathcal O_{S,s}\leq\dim S\leq d$. Dropping the nonnegative term and combining these inequalities gives $\dim\mathcal O_{Y,y}\leq d+n$.

source.place: Tag 0BAG, lemma-alteration-dimension-general, proof via Tag 0BAE and Properties Tag 04MU.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-scheme-dimension-local-rings] to $Y$: it identifies the topological dimension of $Y$ with $\sup_{y\in Y}\dim\mathcal O_{Y,y}$. Step 2 bounded every term of this supremum by $d+n$, so its defining least-upper-bound property gives $\dim Y\leq d+n$. The identification with stalk dimensions is the cited non-elementary input; only the final supremum inequality is elementary. Neither the identity nor the supremum step requires a finite covering, quasi-compactness, or separatedness.

source.place: Tag 04MU, lemma-dimension, equality of (1) and (2), as used in the proof of Morphisms Tag 0BAG.
